intent: A grave guard dug out of the barrows: a tall rounded bronze helm with a bright brow rim and a masked face over three bands of tarnished bronze scale on a mould-black leather jack, a bone gorget, a moss sash, and a big round bronze shield on the back with a bright worn rim, a raised bone boss and moss creeping over it, so from the high camera the roundel is the first thing seen.
requests: A rigid flag per part: the back shield is a chest part, so it stretches oval on a slim avatar.
